verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say that when a user describes a problem in the feedback widget, an intention is created from the report. Its agent then reads the submission, fills in the intention and proposes the tasks, with tasks managed through a documented task model and CLI. This is first-party documentation only, and the shape and depth of the proposed task set are only briefly described. Missing for 10: detail on the structure of proposed tasks (fields, contracts, review/approval flow), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI turn a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks
